name: streamlink-species-familiarity
command: set statement_timeout='15s';set lock_timeout='1s';select private.process_species_familiarity();delete from cron.job_run_details where runid in (select d.runid from cron.job_run_details d where d.jobid=(select jobid from cron.job where jobname='streamlink-species-familiarity') and d.end_time<now()-interval '7 days' order by d.runid limit 1000);
